contact.faq_q1: How much does a solar system cost?
contact.faq_a1: The cost depends on system size, location, equipment quality, and installation complexity. Use our solar calculator for an estimate, or contact us for a detailed quote.
contact.faq_a2: Residential installations typically take 2–5 days. Commercial and utility-scale projects range from a few weeks to several months depending on scope and complexity.
contact.faq_a3: Solar systems require minimal maintenance. Periodic cleaning of panels and annual inspections ensure optimal performance. Our monitoring system alerts you to any issues.
contact.faq_a4: Yes, we partner with leading financial institutions to offer flexible payment plans, leases, and power purchase agreements tailored to your budget.

about.subtitle: About AbrEnergy
about.values_desc: Our core principles guide every decision we make and every project we deliver.
about.value_clean_energy_desc: Accelerating the global transition to sustainable, zero-emission power generation through innovative solar solutions.
about.value_innovation_desc: Continuously pushing the boundaries of solar technology to deliver smarter, more efficient energy systems.
about.value_sustainability_desc: Committed to environmental stewardship in every aspect of our operations, from design to decommissioning.
about.value_reliability_desc: Delivering durable, high-performance solar installations backed by industry-leading warranties and support.
about.story_desc_1: Founded by a team of renewable energy engineers, AbrEnergy began with a simple mission: make solar power accessible, reliable, and affordable for everyone.
about.story_desc_2: Through strategic partnerships and continuous R&D, we expanded our capabilities across the entire solar value chain — from feasibility studies to full EPC delivery.
about.story_desc_3: Today, AbrEnergy stands as a trusted partner in the region's energy transition, delivering megawatts of clean energy capacity across residential, commercial, and utility-scale projects.
about.milestone_1_desc: AbrEnergy was established with a focus on residential solar consulting and small-scale installations.
about.milestone_2_desc: Expanded into commercial and industrial solar projects, completing our first 1 MW installation.
about.milestone_3_desc: Launched our in-house R&D center, developing proprietary solar monitoring and optimization software.
about.milestone_4_desc: Crossed the 50 MW installed capacity mark and expanded operations across multiple provinces.
about.milestone_5_desc: Achieved 100 MW cumulative capacity, launched utility-scale solar farms, and introduced AI-driven energy management solutions.
about.impact_environmental_desc: Our solar installations offset over 50,000 tons of CO₂ annually, significantly contributing to national carbon reduction targets.
about.impact_technology_desc: We've pioneered novel mounting systems and microgrid controllers that improve solar efficiency by up to 15% in local climate conditions.
about.impact_future_desc: Our roadmap includes developing integrated green hydrogen solutions and next-generation solar storage systems for the region.
about.cta_title: Ready to Join the Solar Revolution?
about.cta_desc: Whether you're a homeowner, business owner, or project developer, our team is ready to help you harness the power of the sun.
